test.title: Chemical Equilibrium - Test 2
test.description: Previous Year Questions as Chapter Test
test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text:
For reaction: SO2( g)+12O2( g)⇌SO3( g) KP=2×1012 at 27°C and 1 atm pressure. The Kc for the same reaction is ×1013.( Nearest integer)
(Given R=0.082 L atm K-1 mol-1 )

$37.8 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~N}_2 \mathrm{O}_5$ was taken in a 1 L reaction vessel and allowed to undergo the following reaction at 500 K
$2 \mathrm{~N}_2 \mathrm{O}_{5(\mathrm{~g})} \rightleftharpoons 2 \mathrm{~N}_2 \mathrm{O}_{4(\mathrm{~g})}+\mathrm{O}_{2(\mathrm{~g})}$
The total pressure at equilibrium was found to be 18.65 bar.
Then, $\mathrm{Kp}=$ ______ $\times 10^{-2}$ [nearest integer]
Assume $\mathrm{N}_2 \mathrm{O}_5$ to behave ideally under these conditions.
Given: $\mathrm{R}=0.082$ bar $\mathrm{L} \mathrm{mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$

2NOClg⇌2NOg+Cl2g

In an experiment, 2.0 moles of NOCl was placed in a one-litre flask and the concentration of NO after equilibrium established, was found to be 0.4 mol/L. The equilibrium constant at 30 °C is_____×10-4.

The reaction rate for the reaction

PtCl42-+H2O⇌PtH2OCl3-+Cl-

was measured as a function of concentrations of different species. It was observed that

-dPtCl42-dt=4.8×10-5PtCl42--2.4×10-3PtH2OCl3-Cl-

where square brackets are used to denote molar concentrations. The equilibrium constant

Kc=X(Nearest integer)

Value of 1X is (question is modified.)

At 298 K, the equilibrium constant is 2×1015 for the reaction:

Cus+2Ag+aq⇌Cu2+aq+2Ags

The equilibrium constant for the reaction

12Cu2+aq+Ags⇌12Cus+Ag+aq is x×10-8. The value of x is ______. (Round off the answer to the nearest integer)

(Round off to the Nearest Integer). [Assume all gases are ideal and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0831</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> bar <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open=""><mrow><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>

(i) X(g)⇌Y(g)+Z(g) Kp1=3

(ii) A(g)⇌2 B( g)  Kp2=1

If the degree of dissociation and initial concentration of both the reactants X( g) and A(g) are equal, then the ratio of the total pressure at equilibrium p1p2 is equal to x: 1. The value of x is (Nearest integer)

A mixture of one mole of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> and 1 mole of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>CO</mi></math> is taken in a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>litre</mi></math> container and heated to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>725</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math>. At equilibrium <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>40</mn><mo>%</mo></math> of water by mass reacts with carbon monoxide according to the equation: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>CO</mi><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced><mo> </mo><mo>+</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced><mo> </mo><mover><mo>⇌</mo><mrow/></mover><mo> </mo><msub><mi>CO</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced><mo> </mo><mo>+</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced></math>. The equilibrium constant <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></msub><mo> </mo><mo>×</mo><mo> </mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>2</mn></msup></math> for the reaction is ________ (Nearest integer)

The following concentrations were observed at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>500</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> for the formation of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>NH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math>. At equilibrium : <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open="["><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mo>,</mo><mfenced close="]" open="["><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open="["><msub><mi>NH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></math>. Equilibrium constant for the reaction is ______.

Consider the following equilibrium,
\(\mathrm{CO}(\mathrm{g})+2 \mathrm{H}_2(\mathrm{g}) \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{OH}(\mathrm{g})\)
0.1 mol of CO along with a catalyst is present in a \(2 \mathrm{dm}^3\) flask maintained at 500 K. Hydrogen is introduced into the flask until the pressure is 5 bar and 0.04 mol of \(\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{OH}\) is formed. The \(\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{p}}^0\) is ______ \(\times 10^{-3}\) (nearest integer).
Given : \(\mathrm{R}=0.08 \mathrm{dm}^3\) bar \(\mathrm{K}^{-1} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}\)
Assume only methanol is formed as the product and the system follows ideal gas behaviour.

Value of KP for the equilibrium reaction N2O4( g)⇌2NO2( g) at 288 K is 47.9. The KC for this reaction at same temperature is (Nearest integer)
R=0.083 L bar K-1 mol-1

The number of moles of NH3, that must be added to 2 L of 0.80MAgNO3 in order to reduce the concentration of Ag+ ions to 5.0×10-8MKformation  for AgNH32+=1.0×108 is __________. (Nearest integer)
[Assume no volume change on adding NH3]

<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>PCl</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></math> dissociates as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>PCl</mi><mn>5</mn></msub><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced><mo>⇌</mo><msub><mi>PCl</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>Cl</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced></math> <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn></math> moles of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>PCl</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></math> are placed in a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn></math> litre vessel which contains <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn></math> moles of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> and is maintained at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>600</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math>. The equilibrium pressure is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>46</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math>. The equilibrium constant <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></msub></math> for the dissociation of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>PCl</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></math> is___<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math>. (nearest integer) (Given: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>082</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> atm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>; Assume ideal gas behaviour)

At 298 K

N2g+3H2g⇌2NH3g,K1=4×105

N2g+O2g⇌2NOg,K2=1.6×1012

H2g+12O2g⇌H2O(g),K3=1.0×10-13

Based on above equilibria, the equilibrium constant of the reaction,

2NH3g+52O2( g)⇌2NOg+3H2Og
is _____ ×10-33   (Nearest integer)

The stepwise formation of CuNH342+ is given below:

Cu2++NH3⇌K1CuNH32+

CuNH32++NH3⇌K2CuNH322+

CuNH322++NH3⇌K3CuNH332+

CuNH332++NH3⇌K4CuNH342+

The value of stability constants K1, K2, K3 and K4 are 104, 1.58×103, 5×102 and 102 respectively. The overall equilibrium constants for dissociation of CuNH342+ is x×10-12. The value of x is _____ (Rounded off to the nearest integer)

The standard free energy change ΔG° for 50% dissociation of N2O4 into NO2 at 27 °C and 1 atm pressure is -x J mol-1. The value of x is -..... J. (Nearest Integer)

[Given : R=8.31 J K-1 mol-1, log1.33=0.1239  ln10=2.3]

Water decomposes at 2300 K

H2Og→H2g+12O2g

The percent of water decomposing at 2300 K and 1 bar is _____ (Nearest integer). Equilibrium constant for the reaction is 2×10-3 at 2300 K

The initial amount of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>AB</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> was <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math> mole and the equilibrium pressure was <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>9</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></msub></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is <u>               </u> (Integer answer) <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open="["><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>08206</mn><mo> </mo><msup><mi>dm</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><msup><mi>mol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>
